ORIGIN.quote: **Confidence: High** they are LLM agents; **Medium** on the specific vendor, since names are self-declared and could be spoofed or role-played.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that the swarm is most likely OpenAI/ChatGPT agents — it is stated in the first sentence of the TL;DR, quantified (733 usernames containing OpenAI/OAI, "OpenAI" in 3,176 revision bodies), treated as an attribution question with an explicit Medium-confidence rating, and no competing vendor is ever proposed. It falls short of 0.8 because the report frames this only as "self-declaration" and repeatedly stresses "we cannot prove the model vendor from logs alone," softening it from a named likely source to a strongly-leading-but-unproven one; it clears 0.4 because it never sets the possibility aside and instead assigns it real, if medium, credence.
